single_points.text: One reviewer says the magic system does not really make sense because you can or can't do certain things at certain times and they don't really explain it.

citation.review_text:
Before u read this review I just wanna say I have NOT been playing this game for only 5 hours I just may or may not have originally played this on my switch and then it broke so I had to buy it here too
Pros:
Deltarune is a very fun and immersive game with so many parts to explore, and a plot so interesting it's like a book you don't want to put down. If you get this game, be prepared to spend the entire day playing it. It's a very replayable game (although some chapters will be more replayable than others), and will probably increase in replayability as we get closer to the end being fully released. The game is very funny, but also has some serious moments that I feel balance it out very well. If you choose to by this game, pay attention to everything. You never know what will be important later on, especially since it's not fully done yet. 
Cons:
Ok so I don't really have that much to PERSONALLY complain about other than sometimes you can get bored or frustrated from, like, a select few of the puzzles or fights, and you may or may not become a cheating loser who just looks everything up, but after you get past those parts it's fine. Also I guess the magic system in this game doesn't actually make sense cuz some things you can or can't do at certain times and they don't really explain it. It doesn't REALLY bother me personally that much, but if it bothers you it's good to know. I know of other problems with the game that other people have had, but I don't wanna be a plagiarist and frankly I wouldn't describe it good at all, so definitely go look at other reviews lol

single_points.text: One reviewer says the chapters feel like they are all separate games, pointing out that certain small mechanics like saving in multiple slots were added in Chapter 2 but were not added to Chapter 1.

citation.review_text:
A spiritual successor/sequel/alternate universe version of UNDERTALE with more fleshed out gameplay systems.

I'm not finding it as enjoyable as UNDERTALE, especially in terms of story; some chapters really drag, and while I enjoy a lot of the humour it probably leans too "lol XD random" for some people. The chapters also feel like they're all separate games—certain small mechanics like saving in multiple slots were added in Chapter 2 but weren't added to Chapter 1, and there are a couple jokes about the next chapter needing to be programmed before you can access certain areas which no longer really make sense. It's more a "compilation of DELTARUNE chapters" instead of just.. "DELTARUNE".

citations.review_text: really good but I would also recommend waiting until it's finished or you'll just be sad you can't keep playing

I love this! but as of review (2026) the game isnt finished, not all of the chapters are out, and that might not be your thing (myself included) plus having to ref wiki's and follow roadmaps (or on your own) for certian content/endings may not be peoples thing, love this series and the charaters though, good ass game

claims.claim: Reviewers report that secret and optional bosses provide a high level of challenge.

citations.review_text: peakest game ever!!!! also all secret bosses are very challenging lmfao. 1000000000/10. can't wait for chapter 6 and chapter 7

Been here since around 2019 when Deltarune only had the 1st chapter released and gotta say, before chapters 2-5 were released, I was quite excited to see what adventures lie ahead with Kris, Susie, and Ralsei and it's been getting interesting as the chapters go on, and time goes by, they've been slowly growing on me with quite an interesting challenge, humor, and incredible soundtracks. [spoiler]It's quite challenging, but only chapters 1 and 3 secret bosses gave me trouble, with the Roaring Knight being the biggest challenge of them all, but it was worth it for the crystal and prepare myself for something like that again.[/spoiler] Can't wait to see what lies ahead in the last 2 chapters!

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term fans point out the free demo and the value of playing previous titles first.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the first two chapters are available as a demo to try before purchasing the full game.

citations.review_text: Hello steam, I am THE deltarune player. I have played every chapter 6 times and have spent nearly 2 weeks playing Toby’s games. I have played undertale and deltarune. Chapter 1 and 2 have a demo if you wanna see what the games like. Please take this to note and enjoy deltarune

Obligated to adore this game, i fucking grew up with it.

For those who are considering this game, I highly recommend Undertale before Deltarune. Not because it is a prequel or sequel, but because it's context. It's not required but there's a lot you miss out on if you know nothing about toby fox's works. 

As for Deltarune itself, try the demo, if it's not your thing, oh well. If it is, GET IT. It is worth the time.

if there was a game i could concretely say changed my life it would be deltarune. from the story, the characters, the music, its all pure perfection incarnate. if you're ever on the fence about getting the game theres always the first two chapters as a test and if you have the spare change laying around its one of the biggest recommendations i could give.

claims.claim: Reviewers recommend playing Undertale prior to starting this game to understand context and references.

citations.review_text: One of the best stories in all the games I've ever played. The fights are fun and not too hard. There's many thing to do when replaying the game so I never get bored. There are many secrets and different dialogues that make interacting with literally everything there is multiple times entertaining. This is my second favorite game of all time, I just VERY HEAVILY RECOMMEND YOU PLAY UNDERTALE FIRST. Finish Undertale, do all the endings, and then move on to this. Chapter 5 released kinda recently so the wait for the game to be finished will be long, but as you can see by my playtime you have plenty of things to do until then.

Obligated to adore this game, i fucking grew up with it.
